sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
This card is perfect for attacking, with 6 attack and 3 defense it can defeat almost all enemy cards. Also it doesn't have any costs, but you can better use [[LGS-018|Dominator: The Professor's Top Terrorizer]] because it has 6 attack and 5 defense at no costs. [[SAS-027|Brahe: Lumbering Hulk]] is also a good replacement as he has the same attack and defense as Janus Knight but is also [[TCG:Unblockable|Unblockable]] and cannot be target by opposing heroes.
